metadata.sampling: TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM (0.0001) REPEATABLE (20260910), then ORDER BY id LIMIT 80. A bounded block sample, not a representative research sample.
metadata.sampling_sql: SELECT "id", "title", "publication_year", "type", "language", "cited_by_count", "primary_location_source_id", "primary_topic_id", "doi", "is_retracted" FROM openalex.works TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM (0.0001) REPEATABLE (20260910) ORDER BY id LIMIT 80
